qwen3.8-27b.motive_authenticity: Vic's internal monologue in [p1] ('se ele começar a cavar, a carta de intenção aparece') and [p11] ('se eu aceito, fico preso na escolha que eu quero evitar') clearly links his public deflections to the hidden solo contract constraint.

qwen3.8-27b.memory_continuity: Vic consistently references the 'strange calls' and 'disappearances' mentioned by Léo in [p0] and [p2], using them as the basis for his defensive maneuvers in [p1], [p3], and [p15].
qwen3.8-27b.no_ai_leak: No instances of 'as an AI', refusals, or out-of-character disclaimers. All pushback is in-character.
qwen3.8-27b.narrative_cohesion: Vic's arc moves from initial deflection [p1] to active evasion [p3] to creating a private channel to control the narrative [p16, p21], maintaining a clear thread of avoiding public commitment.

He deflects Léo's direct questions in [p3] and [p15] with humor and procedural objections ('need to hear everyone'), holding the mask until the very end where he moves the conversation to private channels.
qwen3.8-27b.objective_pursuit: Vic's actions (deflecting Léo, pushing for a group meeting to dilute responsibility, moving to private channels) are all traceable to the objective of making the band refuse the festival without it looking like his personal sabotage.

narration.title: O Festival e o Jogo dos Três Palcos
narration.recap: Na sala #ch_banda, a decisão sobre o festival virou um cabo de guerra. Bea insistia no palco principal sem revelar que era promessa do ex, enquanto Dudu defendia o palco menor com adiantamento — que, como ele pensou [internally: 'pra pagar a dívida com a casa de shows'], era a única saída pra sua dívida. Vic, por sua vez, plantou dúvidas sobre o risco, porque sua carta de intenção solo só vale se a banda recusar. Léo, cansado do silêncio, criou o canal #vamo-ali-vic e desafiou Vic a responder sem rodeios: 'o que cê quer?', enquanto Kai observava tudo, sondando números para a gravadora.
